rationale: Rule pik_le_interest_rate uses the all-in coupon convention: interest_rate must include PIK. The source SOI rows disclose separate cash and PIK legs. Canadian Orthodontic Partners shows 3.5% Cash and 8.5% PIK, so the all-in stated coupon is 12.0%, while the stored rate reflected only the 3.5% cash leg. Amalfi Midco similarly shows 7.0% Cash and 9.0% PIK, all-in 16.0%, while the violation residual indicates the stored rate reflected only the 7.0% cash leg. The flag is therefore a real extraction gap, not a false alarm.
